about: Games to play with friends on a rented server. Each game gets its own page /servers/<slug>/ (src/pages/servers/[game].astro) and, for the accounts that ask for it, a Bluesky post 'play together' (coop block in data/accounts.json, scripts/lib/coop-posts.mjs). A new game = one more block here, no code change. Every fact is copied from the named source on checkedOn; no prices (they change). tags decide which accounts may post the game (coop.anyTags of the account). hosts: key = a host from src/lib/hosts.ts, path = the page of this game on the host's site (the affiliate mark is added by the code), facts = what that page says. posts = ready English lines for the post (no link, no tags, no Ad: the template of the account adds them); they rotate. image = Steam header picture (taken from Steam's own appdetails answer, like the deal covers).

games.title: Stardew Valley
games.intro: A farming life game: you inherit an old farm plot, grow crops, raise animals and get to know the people of the valley.

facts.text: Up to 8 players can farm together: the host invites 1 to 7 friends to the valley online.
Steam lists online co-op, LAN co-op and split-screen co-op.

facts: A built-in SMAPI mod manager with one-click installs.
A live farm map and a console in the control panel.
A server password, so only your friends can join.

posts:
Stardew Valley is up to 8-player farming: the host invites 1 to 7 friends to the valley online.
A rented server keeps the farm open when the host logs off.

One farm, up to 8 farmers. Stardew Valley lets you share a farm online with up to 7 friends.
With your own server, nobody has to stay online so the others can play.

Planting season with friends? Stardew Valley has online co-op for up to 8 players.
Here is what a Stardew Valley server gives you, in plain words.

games.title: Core Keeper
games.intro: A mining sandbox adventure in a huge underground cavern: you dig, build a base, farm, craft and explore at your own pace.

facts.text: Online co-op for 2 to 8 players, drop-in and drop-out.
The game itself mentions hosting your own dedicated server.

facts: Database backups every 30 minutes, kept for 5 days.
Admins can be added in one click.
A server password, so only your friends can join.

posts:
Core Keeper is a mining sandbox for 2 to 8 players, with drop-in, drop-out online co-op.
A rented server keeps your underground base online for the whole group.

Dig, farm and build a base together: Core Keeper has online co-op for up to 8 players.
With your own server, friends can drop in any time, even when you are offline.

Want a shared Core Keeper world that is always there? The game supports dedicated servers.
Here is what a Core Keeper server gives you, in plain words.

facts.text: Steam lists online co-op and online PvP.

posts:
Terraria with friends, any time: a rented server keeps your world online when you log off.

Modded Terraria with friends? Some hosts support tModLoader on their servers.

posts:
Necesse lets you build one big settlement together, or run a dedicated server for many players.
A rented server keeps the colony running when you log off.

Colony building with friends: Necesse supports co-op and dedicated servers.
